claims.statement: The operations at the proposed water-based paint manufacturing facility in Madhya Pradesh would commence within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance.
claims.quote: The operations at the proposed facility would commence within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance for setting up of the manufacturing facility by the Company.
claims.horizon: within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance

claims.statement: The second paint manufacturing facility in the United Arab Emirates is planned with an estimated investment of AED 140 million and initial capacity of 55,800 KL per annum.
claims.quote: During the year, Berger Paints Emirates Ltd Co (L.L.C), UAE, a step‑down subsidiary of Asian Paints International Private Limited, Singapore, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, initiated the process for setting up its second  paint manufacturing facility in the United Arab Emirates with an estimated investment of AED 140 million (~₹ 340 crores) with an initial capacity of 55,800 KL per annum.
claims.target: AED 140 million investment and 55,800 KL per annum initial capacity

claims.statement: The proposed water-based paint manufacturing facility in Madhya Pradesh will have a capacity of 4 lakh KL per annum and an estimated investment of approximately ₹2,000 crores.
claims.quote: The Company had announced its proposal to set up a  water-based paint manufacturing facility in the State of Madhya Pradesh with a proposed capacity of 4 lakh KL per annum and an estimated investment of ~` 2,000 crores.
claims.target: 4 lakh KL per annum capacity and ~₹2,000 crores investment

claims.statement: The record date for determining entitlement to the final dividend for the financial year 2025-26 is 23rd June 2026.
claims.quote: The record date for determining entitlement to the final dividend is  23rd June 2026.

claims.statement: If approved by shareholders, the final dividend of ₹23 per equity share will be paid on or after 13th July 2026.
claims.quote: If approved, the final dividend will be paid  on or after 13th July 2026.

facts.statement: The Company has long-term borrowings of ₹805.42 crores as of 31st March 2026.
facts.quote: The Company has long-term borrowings of ` 805.42 crores  as on 31st March 2026, arising pursuant to the amalgamation  of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited, a wholly owned  subsidiary of the Company, with the Company.

facts.statement: Cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances, term deposits, and mutual funds on a standalone basis stood at ₹9,014.60 crores as on 31st March 2026.
facts.quote: Cash and cash equivalents and other balances with Banks  (excluding earmarked balances), current/non-current  term deposits as disclosed in other financial assets,  investments in debentures or bonds (including interest  accrued on the same) and mutual funds on a standalone basis  as on 31st March 2026, stood at ₹ 9,014.60 crores as against  ₹ 4,533.55 crores in the previous financial year.

facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations for the financial year 2025-26 was ₹30,769.48 crores, representing a 4.10% growth.
Consolidated revenue from operations for the financial year 2025-26 was ₹35,583.54 crores, representing a 4.95% growth.
On a standalone basis, the Company spent ₹1,177.99 crores towards capital expenditure during the financial year 2025-26.
facts.quote: During the year, the Company, on a standalone basis, spent  ₹ 1,177.99 crores towards capital expenditure against  ₹ 1,467.19 crores in the previous financial year.
